offering_description.value: Provides undergraduate and graduate education, primarily online, to working adults in the United States. It also offers university and vocational programs online and on campus in Australia and New Zealand. It provides online courses for transferable college credit and helps employers administer education benefits.

primary_services.value: undergraduate and graduate education; vocational education and training; online courses for transferable college credit; employer education benefits administration

customer_segment.value: B2C: Working adults, university and vocational students, and learners seeking transferable college credit; B2B: Employers offering tuition assistance and other education benefits to their employees

end_markets.value: higher education; vocational education; college credit transfer; employer-sponsored workforce education

revenue_model.value: service fees: Tuition and fees for university and vocational programs; subscription: Recurring access to online courses eligible for college credit transfer

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Develops curricula and delivers instruction through faculty to university and vocational students; software / platform: Delivers self-paced courses to learners and administers education benefits for employers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Australia and New Zealand

specialization.value: related lines: University degrees, vocational training, transferable college courses and employer education benefits administration

distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; direct sales; partners / resellers
